scientific_integrity: The global arbitrary-positive-weights result is proved analytically. Exact rational finite tests are corroborative only. Same-model review is not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for rooted depth-one stars, strictly positive squared-error vertex masses and positive edge-variation weights; not general trees, differently oriented stars or other losses. An equal-mass, equal-variation-weight specialization is covered by an earlier unweighted-tree result. Historical priority of the weighted design has not been independently established.
title: Sharp weighted star isotonic variation modulus and optimal stabilizing edge weights
